decisions: Existing uploads keep exif_transpose-v1; 1308 explicitly ignores confirmed-invalid EXIF Orientation=8.
Source and artifact scores are non-compensating; total is their minimum and every failed check is a hard gate.
Repairs may mutate only a source-bound structure contract and stop after two attempts.
Jamb support requires detailed same-wall or explicit return-wall solid provenance; bare booleans are insufficient.
next_action: Resolve and independently freeze the 12 recorded 1308 reference blockers before emitting a strict buildable bundle; do not reuse an old Blend file.
stage_boundary: Stage A delivers a fail-closed resume/score/repair skeleton and source-bound geometry gates. Per-operation repair parameter schemas and complete raw-to-canonical source scoring are explicit Stage B/P2 work, not claimed as Stage A completion.
rejection: The first candidate was rejected for self-reported anchor checks, non-atomic junction acceptance, score identity gaps, fake-complete state, shallow repair scans, missing orientation UI, and mesh-void blindness. All listed P1 paths now have deterministic negative tests; an independent recheck is still required.
